acceptedClaims.declaredStatement: Using the accepted premise-bound 30-row system and finite-grid posterior-measure reduction of transactions e3c1036ca607539a5ebcddf3058e6014ac5c1cd9 and e2bbc1e210e496b3c834e658820fc90287f3b2c0, respectively: (i) every binary-input receiver curve obeys |J_A(p)-J_A(p')| <= 2 h_2(|p-p'|); (ii) the generalized mean-one-half posterior-measure receiver curves form a compact subset of C([0,1]) whose finite-output curves are uniformly dense, and for every N-point grid Q containing {0,1/2,1} there is an at-most-N-output exact grid match with sup-norm error at most min{1,4 h_2(Delta_Q)}, preserving an already reflected pair on reflection-closed Q; and (iii) replacing G,K by curves within epsilon_G,epsilon_K changes every one of the accepted 30 row right sides by at most a_r epsilon_G+b_r epsilon_K with the displayed audited coefficients, universally at most 4 epsilon_G+4 epsilon_K. Hence the same hierarchy is feasible under those explicit row relaxations, and strictly feasible witnesses persist under sufficiently fine approximations. No unrelaxed optimized-value convergence, exact full-functional cardinality, reflected optimality, minimax interchange, numerical capacity improvement, or exact sum-capacity is asserted.
acceptedClaims.validitySummary: Under the accepted 30-row system and posterior-measure reduction, the argument establishes the binary-input receiver-curve modulus, compactness and finite-output uniform density of generalized receiver curves, exact finite-grid matching with the stated cardinality and error bounds, preservation of already reflected pairs on reflection-closed grids, and stability of all 30 row right sides with the audited coefficients and universal bound. It consequently establishes feasibility for the explicitly relaxed approximating systems and persistence of strictly feasible witnesses under sufficiently fine approximations.
scopeQualifications: Computational attestations check the encoded dependency list, 30-row coefficient algebra, global coefficient bound, and tested grid formulas; the entropy, compactness, Carathéodory, and arbitrary-grid arguments are established mathematically rather than by those computations.
Feasibility is established under explicit row relaxations; no unrelaxed optimized-value convergence is proved.
No exact full-functional cardinality bound, minimax interchange, numerical capacity improvement, or exact sum-capacity is established.
The approximation result preserves an already reflected receiver pair on a reflection-closed grid; it does not symmetrize arbitrary pairs or establish reflected optimality.
Validity is premise-bound to the accepted 30-row system from e3c1036ca607539a5ebcddf3058e6014ac5c1cd9, including its external theorem premise.
